name: Aspect of the Horse
body:
School transmutation (polymorph); Level cleric/oracle 2, druid 3, ranger 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S. M (strand of horse hair)

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 min./level

DESCRIPTION

When you cast this spell, you take on the aspect of a heavy warhorse. Your teeth grow large and square, your hair long, and your feet heavy and hoof-like, which can be used for defense. You gain a +4 enhancement bonus to Constitution, your base speed increases by 20 ft., and you add +4 to your CMD vs. trip. You become immune to fatigue for the duration of the spell. Furthermore, when you are hit with an attack of opportunity, you may make a single attack with your hooves against the opponent that hit you as an immediate action. This attack uses your highest base attack bonus plus your Strength bonus, and deals 1d6 points of bludgeoning damage (if you are Medium; 1d4 points of damage if you are small) plus your Strength modifier on a successful hit.
